description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Animate UI 提供可安装的动画化 React 基础组件，覆盖 Radix UI、Base UI 与 React Aria，并可通过 npx @animate-ui/cli@latest animate all 一次性安装。站点还列出 Accordion、Checkbox、Dialog、Combobox 等组件文档，以及 Icons、Backgrounds 和面向 AI agent 的 Skills 入口。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Animate UI (https://animate-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react, radix-ui, base-ui, motion.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
